ogDesc: Krabi vs Phuket — which fits your trip?
intro: Both sit on the Andaman coast and share the same rainy season, but the vibe is quite different. Here's a straight, side-by-side comparison.
quickAnswerHtml: Short answer: Pick Phuket for convenience — a direct international airport and hotels, restaurants and nightlife at every level. Pick Krabi for a quieter vibe, dramatic limestone cliffs, and a closer base for Phi Phi/four-island tours. Both rain on the same schedule (May-October).

blocks.html: Short answer: Krabi and Phuket are both on the Andaman coast and rain on the same schedule (May-October), but the vibe is quite different. Phuket is Thailand's biggest beach destination — a direct international airport, and hotels, restaurants and nightlife at every price level. Krabi is smaller and quieter, known for the limestone cliffs at Railay and Ao Nang, and it's a closer base for Phi Phi Island and four-island tours — better suited to travelers who want a more relaxed pace than Phuket's buzz.

items: Pick Phuket if you want convenience, direct flights, and hotels/restaurants/nightlife at every level
Pick Krabi if you want a quieter pace, dramatic limestone scenery, and a closer base for Phi Phi tours
Do both — many travelers fly into Phuket, spend 2-3 days, then head overland or by boat to Krabi for 2-3 more, getting both convenience and calm

faq.q: Do Krabi and Phuket rain at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Both are on the Andaman coast and get their heaviest rain May-October, unlike the Gulf coast (Koh Samui), which rains on a different schedule.

faq.q: Do I need to fly into Phuket to get to Krabi?
faq.a: No, Krabi has its own airport, though with fewer direct flights than Phuket. Some routes connect through Phuket or Bangkok instead.

faq.q: Which is closer to Phi Phi Island, Krabi or Phuket?
faq.a: Krabi is slightly closer — boats from Ao Nang take less time than from Phuket — but both offer regular Phi Phi Island tours.
